title: ophrys lutea subsp. phryganae
intro: Ophrys lutea subsp. phryganae, commonly known as Bee Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the genus Ophrys and is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is known for its unique shape and color, often attracting bees for pollination purposes. The health benefits of Ophrys lutea subsp. phryganae include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-allergic and anti-anaphylactic effects.
